descriptions.d31j_init_mesh_instance_801809d4: Runs the base init; clears four references; creates the instance and a texture chosen by option bit 16; names the instance 'Instance-<item text>'; resets three colour vectors and copies them to the texture; stores descriptor and clip; copies option bits into the flag word; builds optional rig, hook and extra nodes through the service factory; appends the clip to the instance and the instance to the kind's registry entry; counts the instance.
